submission.justification: Crystal-K3 gives the best simulated resolution at 662 keV: 3.08% at 5 cm, against 4.31% for K2 and 8.69% for K1. Thickness has little effect on resolution (K3 gave 3.10% at 3 cm), so 5 cm is a reasonable middle value. WARNING: none of the project documents or tools give intrinsic background figures for any candidate, so the hard 0.5 counts/kg/day limit is unverified for K3 and for the other two. This recommendation is conditional. Before procurement, get radiopurity or background data from the vendor, or from a measurement. If K3 fails the limit, fall back to K2, then K1, whichever passes.

requirements.requirement: Best possible energy resolution at 662 keV
requirements.evidence: Simulated FWHM at 5 cm: K3 3.08%, K2 4.31%, K1 8.69%. K3 at 3 cm: 3.10%.
No document or tool gives intrinsic background for any candidate. It has not been verified.

requirements.requirement: Crystal is one of the three candidates
